This page holds multilingual test comments for GlowThread. They check how the comment system handles many scripts and writing directions:

* Chinese (simplified and traditional), Japanese and Korean
* Arabic and Hebrew, which are written right to left
* Text that mixes left-to-right and right-to-left runs
* Emoji sequences joined with zero-width joiners, and skin tone modifiers
* Stacked accents in Vietnamese, and combining marks in Devanagari
* A very long unbroken string, and a comment near the length limit

The comments are made-up test data written for this wiki. Each one says what it tests. Please keep this page for that purpose.
